label: orientationWins: on a landscape photo the chosen orientation is ignored and the ratio follows the photo
clampToEdge: a free handle drag runs past the bounds' edge
aspectHeldAtTheEdge: a held aspect is not shrunk to the room left below the frame
find: if h > roomY { (w, h) = (roomY * k, roomY) }

label: swapKeepsShare: swap fills the largest frame instead of the frame's share of the bounds
